report.title: Search is not case-idependent in non-EN locale
report.body: ### Pre-submission Checklist - [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet - [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version ### Where did you encounter this bug? Latest stable version (self-hosted) ### Memos Version v0.26 ### Bug Description Seems like the search is not case-independent when memos content is not in English. ### Steps to Reproduce 1. Create a memo: ``` **Рецепты** **Сырники**: **Блины** **Выход** 12-13 шт (большая сковородка), 12 - молоко 400 (500) мл ``` 2. Search for "блины" -> no results found. Searching for "Блины" (note capital Б) works fine though. ### Expected Behavior I expect search to be case-independent by default (and it seems to be working like this for English) ### Screenshots & Additional Context

preconditions: no memos exist yet in the fresh install
steps: Click the memo editor input on the home page to focus it

Type the memo content: "**Рецепты**", then a blank line, "**Сырники**:", then two blank lines, "**Блины**", a new line, "**Выход** 12-13 шт (большая сковородка), 12", a new line, "- молоко 400 (500) мл"
Click the Save button to create the memo
Type "блины" (lowercase б) into the search box
Press Enter to run the search
plan.expected: the memo containing "Блины" is shown in the search results after searching for "блины", the same as when searching for "Блины"
plan.reported_actual: searching for lowercase "блины" returns no results, while searching for "Блины" with a capital Б finds the memo

# Search is not case-idependent in non-EN locale

## Sign in
Sign in with username {{username}} and password {{password}}.
Verify the sign-in form is gone and the memo app's main page is shown.

## Reproduce the report
Open http://localhost:15305/.
Stay on localhost:15305 for the whole run and do not open any other website.
Do each step once, in order. If the app behaves unexpectedly, do not undo, retry, repair or work around it: the behavior itself is what is being checked. Check the result right after the last step.
Steps:
1. Click the memo editor input on the home page to focus it
2. Type the memo content: "**Рецепты**", then a blank line, "**Сырники**:", then two blank lines, "**Блины**", a new line, "**Выход** 12-13 шт (большая сковородка), 12", a new line, "- молоко 400 (500) мл"
3. Click the Save button to create the memo
4. Click the search box
5. Type "блины" (lowercase б) into the search box
6. Press Enter to run the search
The reporter says the correct behavior is that the memo containing "Блины" is shown in the search results after searching for "блины", the same as when searching for "Блины".
